game: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom 1.2.0 (title 0100F2C0115B6000), yuzu-family emulator LayeredFS mods

tools.name: Switch Toolbox
tools.role: BFRES load / save behind tools/TotkMdl (headless, net48); its tegra_swizzle_x64.dll does the block-linear swizzle for txtg.py and make_icons.py

tools.name: TotkMdl (tools/TotkMdl)
tools.role: info / export / replace / anims: skeleton, smooth-matrix list, shapes with vertices and weights as JSON; replace with delete, copyMaterials, samplerTextures, smoothBones, newShapes, shapeMaterial, renameMaterials and per-shape weightFormat (float / signed skin weights)

tools.name: Blender
tools.role: scripts/blender: Karin_Original FBX -> karin_dump.npz (game space, unique vertices), shape-key deltas, packed textures to PNG, object inventory, three-view preview renders of TotkMdl JSON

tools.name: Python build chain (scripts/)
tools.role: build_karin (per-segment similarity retarget, head scale / drop, shoulder squash, leg radial scale, skirt and borrowed cloth bones, face and blink fit, material renames), make_textures / make_icons (TexToGo and BNTX), package (mod folder + merged RESTBL), assemble_package (Full / Lite release); libraries retarget, tk, mc, totkfs, byml7, txtg, fska, face_anim, face_rig

tools.name: NxExtract (tools/NxExtract) + LibHac
tools.version: LibHac 0.19.0 (nuget, MIT), net8.0, driven from pwsh 7.4 by nxx.ps1
tools.role: base XCI program NCA + update NCA -> romfs listing / glob extraction (replaces yuzu's Dump RomFS, which hung in Banc/)

tools.name: PhysicsTool + bphcl probe (tools/bphcl_probe)
tools.version: PhysicsTool 2.2.0 (KB0MB/PhysicsTool), net10.0; run through the dotnet host with DOTNET_EnableCETCompat=0
tools.role: read Armor_*.bphcl Havok cloth: driven bones per cloth and the particle triangle behind each bone (fixed particles decide hinge / ball-joint behaviour)

tools.name: PowerShell release tools (release/tools)
tools.role: Install.ps1 (yuzu-family install with backups, mod-order warning) and Give-KarinArmor.ps1 (progress.sav armor pouch + IsGet flags, backup first, refuses while an emulator runs)

runtime_boundary: Game 1.2.0 on yuzu EA 4176 (the user's machine). v1-v6d were installed and played by the user: textures (v2), skirt (v3), blinking with signed float weights (v5), ear stretch fix (v6b), bangs and ear behaviour (v6c / v6d) confirmed or reported in game. v7 / v7b / v7c (head scale, neck, shoulders, legs) and the Full / Lite release packages were checked offline only; the v7c remote install was pending at the snapshot. The portable copies were checked offline (2026-11-07): build_karin.py, make_textures.py, make_icons.py and package.py with TOTK_WORK on the project work tree rebuilt the v7c models, textures, icons and RESTBL byte for byte; mc / txtg / pose_test / face_preview / swing_test gave the same output as the originals; assemble_package.py rebuilt the v7c Full / Lite trees (only README.md differs: the two example paths); Give-KarinArmor.ps1 is byte-identical to the shipped copy and is tested on synthetic saves. TotkMdl, NxExtract and the probe are the project sources; only their project files were changed to take dependency paths as properties.
python: 3.10+ (tested with 3.14.0); Blender scripts run in Blender 5.0's Python
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/requirements.txt (from bundle root)
